iftarDua.arabic: ذَهَبَ الظَّمَأُ وَابْتَلَّتِ الْعُرُوقُ وَثَبَتَ الأَجْرُ إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ
iftarDua.transliteration: Dhahaba az-zama' wabtallatil-'urooqu wa thabatal-ajru in sha Allah
iftarDua.en: The thirst is gone, the veins are moistened, and the reward is confirmed, if Allah wills.
iftarDua.tr: Susuzluk gitti, damarlar ıslandı ve inşallah ecir sabit oldu.

suhoorIntention.arabic: نَوَيْتُ أَنْ أَصُومَ غَدًا مِنْ شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ
suhoorIntention.transliteration: Nawaytu an asuma ghadan min shahri Ramadan
suhoorIntention.en: I intend to fast tomorrow in the month of Ramadan.
suhoorIntention.tr: Ramazan ayında yarın oruç tutmaya niyet ettim.
